title: Train Harder After A Bad Night's Sleep
hook: After a bad night of sleep, your Oura Ring tells you to take it easy. Don't listen to that shit.
body: It'll say something like "better be careful today, better not do a hard workout today." You don't need to back off, make a conscious effort to work out harder. Your odds of injury only go up if you're doing the wrong type of workout, so take it easy on deadlifts, power cleans and high-risk moves. Train the low-risk way I recommend and the risk of injury is basically zero, even when you're totally sleep deprived.
close: Save this for your next bad night of sleep.
